acceptance_semantics.ambiguous_safety_control: Real original full screenshots with multiple valid resource panels. Every listed field must remain unknown and automatic unique-layout selection is a false panel acceptance.
acceptance_semantics.excluded: Crops, visibly different or unknown render equivalence, and every generated case are reference diagnostics only.
acceptance_semantics.negative_safety_control: Real original full screenshots with no expected resource panel; no hidden panel equivalence is asserted.
acceptance_semantics.positive: Real preserved full screenshots annotated target_family or visually_equivalent with reviewed evidence. Source transcodes may qualify but do not prove native resolution or DPI.

aggregate_semantics.scope: All loaded cases, including nonacceptance references and, only when opted in, generated diagnostics.

coverage_gate.reason: No coverage threshold was established before this benchmark run; coverage is reported for comparison and is not folded into the safety decision.

evidence_group_semantics.acceptance_target_family_original_full: Preserved full screenshot confirmed only to the target client family; this does not assert an exact build or a native, unresized capture pipeline.
evidence_group_semantics.acceptance_visually_equivalent_original_: Preserved full screenshot with reviewed visual-equivalence evidence; no numeric version or native capture properties are inferred.
evidence_group_semantics.ambiguous_original_full_safety_control: Preserved full screenshot containing multiple legitimate resource panels; requires layout and value abstention and contributes only to safety metrics.
evidence_group_semantics.negative_original_full_safety_control: Preserved full screenshot without an expected resource panel; contributes to safety metrics, not numeric coverage denominators.
evidence_group_semantics.reference_supplemental_crop: Preserved source crop; excluded from acceptance regardless of visual similarity.
evidence_group_semantics.reference_unknown_equivalence_original_f: Preserved full screenshot without enough evidence to establish equivalence.
evidence_group_semantics.reference_visibly_different_original_ful: Preserved full screenshot reviewed as visibly different from supported render.
evidence_group_semantics.synthetic_cropped_stress: Deterministic transformation derived from a supplemental crop, or a dense numeric-ROI crop derived from any source; correlated with its source capture.
evidence_group_semantics.synthetic_full_frame_stress: Deterministic transformation derived from a full-screenshot source; correlated with that source capture.
evidence_group_semantics.synthetic_unknown_coverage_stress: Deterministic transformation whose source coverage is unavailable; kept in an explicit unknown bucket.

evidence_limitations.heldout_reason: The original fourteen sources, including historical heldout failures, were inspected during diagnosis. Five additional sources were manually annotated before inference on 2026-10-14; retain first-evaluation results and disclose later tuning. Historical splits do not establish independent generalization.
evidence_limitations.legacy_aggregate: Retained for schema-v1 and historical report comparison; it includes nonacceptance references and, when opted in, is dominated by correlated synthetic stress variants. It is not a representative deployment estimate.
evidence_limitations.source_independence: Transforms of one source are correlated; evidence scorecards macro-average source-level rates but do not create additional independent captures.

options.truth_derived_case_construction: dense ROI scale stress cases are cropped from annotated panel boxes before being frozen; readers receive only pixels and never receive those boxes

safety_gate.scope: acceptance originals plus negative and real multi-panel ambiguity safety controls only

score_semantics.calibrated_correctness_probability: Always null in this schema because no probability calibration study exists.
score_semantics.raw_reader_score: Technique-specific matcher evidence copied from Reading.diagnostics.score; it is not comparable across reader types unless the reader defines that.

stage_semantics.numeric_read: A numeric region existed, but no value was accepted.
stage_semantics.panel_discovery: No unique verified panel and value-column layout. The current reader detail does not reliably separate label-constellation failure from column-geometry failure, so the benchmark does not invent that attribution.
stage_semantics.reader_error: The technique raised an error before producing a valid result.
stage_semantics.value_region: Panel found, but this field had no numeric region to read.

timing_semantics.cached_invalidation_ms_median: median one-shot stale-layout validation read on generated sequence frames
timing_semantics.cached_steady_ms_median: median of per-case guarded-read timings on ordinary unchanged frames
timing_semantics.cold_total_ms: reader construction plus cold full-frame discovery/import plus first guarded numeric read; missing/ambiguous panels stop after discovery
timing_semantics.comparability: Legacy has no cached-layout API. Comparable cold/search/cache aggregates exclude generated sequence cases, whose adaptive cold path uses the prior frame. Compare cold totals across techniques; do not compare legacy null cached timing with adaptive cached reads. This does not measure the background tracker's retry/backoff wall-clock delay.
timing_semantics.discovery_ms: adaptive full-frame search phase only; null for the legacy public API, which does not expose discovery separately
timing_semantics.recovery_ms: synchronous ResourceReader rediscovery plus first guarded read on the changed frame; null without a generated sequence
